channel.title: Device Performance Monitor
channel.description: Updates for Device Performance Monitor — live memory, CPU, thread and frame-rate monitoring from Coursion.

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
• AI session analysis — have Claude, GPT, or Gemini review a monitoring session and get a plain-language summary, per-screen diagnosis and fixes, a worst-screens ranking, and anomaly flags. Includes per-screen charts and token counts; switch providers per run.
  • Session history — every stopped session is saved automatically, so you can reopen and analyze any earlier run at any time.
  • Better screen tracking — detects the on-device screen behind each reading, now including React Native routes and Compose/Fragment screens via a DPM_SCREEN log marker, plus a built-in Diagnose tool.
  • Crash reporting and privacy-first analytics for stability and usage insight.
